commit.message:
gh-158936: Resolve lazy imports consistently for dataclass annotations (#158939)

With string annotations, dataclasses looks up the first name of each
annotation to detect ClassVar, InitVar and KW_ONLY. If that name was a
lazy import that could not be resolved, the lookup raised and the class
could not be created, while the same class works with non-string
annotations.

This resolves lazy imports the way annotationlib does: try to resolve
them, and treat a failure like a missing name.

commit.message:
gh-149083: Convert dataclasses.MISSING and dataclasses.KW_ONLY to sentinels (#149086)

There were comments claiming these were implemented as custom classes to give a nicer
repr(), but the repr() wasn't all that nice:

>>> repr(dataclasses.MISSING)
'<dataclasses._MISSING_TYPE object at 0x1005e7e00>'
>>> repr(dataclasses.KW_ONLY)
'<dataclasses._KW_ONLY_TYPE object at 0x100884050>'

Sentinels are conceptually the right tool for these, so let's use them.

This does change the repr() of these two objects.
